name: People Who Are Mean
overview: Scripture reveals that those who are mean or cruel ultimately harm themselves, as Proverbs 11:17 highlights the self-destructive nature of cruelty compared to the blessing of mercy. Believers are encouraged not to envy or fret over evildoers (Psalms 37:1), but to remain steadfast in trusting God's justice and mercy, as He is longsuffering and abundant in goodness (Exodus 34:6). Wisdom is found in choosing companions carefully, avoiding those who walk in folly (Proverbs 13:20), and guarding one’s heart against negative words that can lead to bitterness (Ecclesiastes 7:21). Through these truths, believers are called to reflect God's gracious character rather than mirroring the meanness they may encounter.
